name: The majority voted in favour of an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-02-29.18.1) introduced by South Australian Senator [Anne Ruston](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/sa/anne_ruston) (Liberal), which means it succeeded. ### Amendment text > *At the end of the motion, add "and, in respect of the [Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Legislation Amendment (Safety and Other Measures) Bill 2024](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fbillhome%2Fr7149%22), the provisions of the bill be referred immediately to the Economics Legislation Committee [for inquiry and report](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Committees/Senate/Economics/OPGSAmend24) by 22 March 2024".*
